module: Node "EndScreen Begin" (default category, color ui). Starts building the end screen of a mission: on the first frame with flow active, it calls modules.ui:startUIBuilding('endScreen'), builds the buttons (Retry, Continue at start, Continue here, custom buttons, next missions) then activates the build pin. The "EndScreen ..." nodes chained afterwards add the panels, and a "Screen Finish" node ends the building. Pins: inputs flow, reset (pulse), change (table, result of an attempt), customBtnsFirst (hidden), contStartActive / contHereActive (hidden, true) and one string pin + one bool "_active" pin per custom button; outputs flow, build (chainFlow), retry, contStart, contHere and one flow per custom button. Runs while flow is active.
notes: The output flow pin is always reset to false at the end of work; only build (one frame) is used to chain the panels.
The "Continue here" button exists in career only if the player uses their own vehicle; in the career tutorial only this button remains.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Initializes open=false, the list of custom buttons, data.includeRetryButton=true and the auto-skip timer.

postInit.desc: Called right after init, once the pins are created.

_executionStarted.desc: Called when the flowgraph project starts executing; resets the node state.

_executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops; closes the dialogue.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the mission on the client side; closes the dialogue.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the custom button list in the flowgraph editor (text field per button, "add" and "rem" buttons). Returns the reason for the change (string) or nil.

updateButtons.desc: Recreates the node's pins for each button name in self.options: string input pin (label), bool input pin "<name>_active" (hidden, true by default) and flow output pin. Reconnects the existing links when the name has not changed.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves the list of custom buttons (options).

_onDeserialized.desc: Reloads the custom buttons then recreates the pins.

buttonPushed.desc: Called when a button is clicked: sets the output pin with the same name as the action to true, then closes the dialogue (navigation to "play").

action.desc: Name of the output pin (contStart, contHere, or name of a custom button).

onResetGameplay.desc: Hook called on a gameplay reset; if the screen is open and the Retry button is included, navigates to "play" and activates the retry pin.

openDialogue.desc: Emits the onEndScreenUIOpened hook and builds the button list: Retry (with career entry fee, disabled if the player cannot pay), Continue at start (or return to scenarios if launched as a scenario), Continue here (outside career, or career with the player's vehicle), tutorial restriction, custom buttons, then "Start Next Mission" buttons. The order is reversed and the first button gets the focus.

closeDialogue.desc: If the screen was built, navigates to the "play" screen to close the end screen.

onNodeReset.desc: Resets the output pins to false and resets open/built.

workOnce.desc: Variant executed only once by the flowgraph engine (empty body here).

work.desc: If reset is active, resets the node. When flow is active and the screen is not yet built, starts the UI building and opens the dialogue. Handles auto-skip: if startingOptions.autoSkipEndScreen is set, stops the mission after 2 s of real time.
